title: 쇼핑 앱 장바구니: 무엇을, 몇 개, 얼마에 사요?
objective: By the end, you can read a Korean shopping app cart and find how many items you are buying, which items are sold out, and the final amount you will pay.
summary: Learners read a Korean shopping app cart screen to find the products, quantities, fees and the final amount to pay.
note: The store name and all prices on this screen are made up for practice.

task.title: Read the cart screens
task.line: Read each short cart screen, then choose, fill in, or answer as the instruction says.

items.text: The list of things you want to buy before you pay.
Checks every product in the cart at once.
items.example: 전체 선택을 누르면 다 같이 주문해요.

items.text: Takes a product out of the cart.
How many of one product you are buying.
The product is gone, so you cannot buy it now.
items.example: 이 신발은 품절이에요. 지금 못 사요.

items.text: The price of the products only, before the discount and delivery fee.
Money taken off the price, shown with a minus (-).
The money you pay for delivery.
You do not pay a delivery fee.
The final amount you will pay.
items.example: 마지막에 결제 예정 금액을 꼭 보세요.

items.text: Press it when you are ready to buy.

sections.heading: Reading tips
paragraphs: Count carefully. (2/3) next to 전체 선택 means 2 of the 3 products are checked, and only checked products are ordered. 수량 is how many of one product you are buying, so 수량 2 means two T-shirts.
Look at the bottom number. 결제 예정 금액 = 상품 금액 - 할인 + 배송비. A product marked 품절 cannot be checked, so it is not in this total.

exercises: Look at the top of the cart and answer in Korean: 전체 선택 (2/4) ① 장바구니에 상품이 몇 개 있어요? ② 몇 개를 선택했어요?
Answer Yes or No: ① 우산 · 품절 — 지금 살 수 있어요? ② 배송비 0원 — 배송비를 내요? ③ 컵 · 수량 3 — 컵을 세 개 사요?
Choose the right button: ① 양말은 필요 없어요. 장바구니에서 빼고 싶어요. (삭제 / 주문하기) ② 다 골랐어요. 이제 사고 싶어요. (삭제 / 주문하기)
Fill in the blank with one word from the screen: 3만 원 이상 사면 ____이에요. 배송비를 안 내요.
Read the cart and choose the amount to pay: 상품 금액 25,000원 / 할인 -5,000원 / 배송비 3,000원 → 결제 예정 금액은 얼마예요? (20,000원 / 23,000원 / 28,000원)
answers: ① 네 개 있어요. (4개) ② 두 개를 선택했어요. (2개)
① No ② No ③ Yes
